description: Implement the Next.js 15 frontend with App Router, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, Phantom wallet integration, Zustand state management, and all pages (Dashboard, Leaderboard, Trader Profile, Copy Settings). Includes vault management UI for creating vaults, depositing/withdrawing, and configuring risk parameters.
steps: Initialize apps/frontend as Next.js 15 app with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Configure package.json with dependencies: @solana/wallet-adapter-react, @solana/wallet-adapter-react-ui, @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets, @solana/web3.js, zustand, recharts, and shadcn/ui setup (tailwind.config.ts with dark theme: gray-950 background, brand purple #9945FF, Solana green #14F195)

Create apps/frontend/src/app/layout.tsx with WalletContextProvider (Phantom adapter), QueryClientProvider, dark theme, and the shared navigation bar (sticky nav with SCT logo, Dashboard/Traders/Copy links, WalletMultiButton)

Create apps/frontend/src/stores/ with Zustand stores: useAuthStore (JWT token, user data, login/logout), useCopyStore (active copy relations, CRUD operations), useWebSocketStore (connection state, message handling, signing request queue), useVaultStore (vault state, balance, risk params)
Create apps/frontend/src/lib/api.ts with typed API client (fetch wrapper with JWT auth header, base URL config, error handling) covering all API endpoints
Create apps/frontend/src/lib/websocket.ts with WebSocket client: connect with JWT query param, handle CONNECTED/SIGNING_REQUEST/TRADE_UPDATE/PONG messages, auto-reconnect, heartbeat PING every 30s

Create apps/frontend/src/app/page.tsx (Dashboard): portfolio PnL cards (24h, 7d), active copied traders count, open positions count, recent trades table (pair, status badge colored by state, P&L, execution latency, DEX). If wallet not connected: hero section with Connect Wallet button and three feature cards

Create apps/frontend/src/app/traders/page.tsx (Leaderboard): sortable table by 7d ROI, 30d ROI, win rate, Sharpe, drawdown, trade count. Columns: rank, wallet (truncated + label), all stats, copiers count, Copy button. Copy button opens modal with trade size, slippage, stop-loss fields
Create apps/frontend/src/app/traders/[id]/page.tsx (Trader Profile): wallet address, label, status badge, PnL line chart (Recharts with 7d/30d/90d switcher), stats grid, recent trades table

Create apps/frontend/src/app/copy/page.tsx (Copy Settings): list active copy relations as cards with trader info, enabled toggle, quick stats. Expandable settings form: copyMode selector, SOL amount, max size, slippage bps, stop-loss %, take-profit %, daily loss limit, token blacklist. Unsubscribe button with confirmation dialog

Create apps/frontend/src/app/vault/page.tsx (Vault Management): vault creation flow, current balance display, deposit/withdraw forms, risk parameter configuration (max trade size, max daily loss, max slippage, max open positions, allowed DEXs checkboxes, token blacklist), pause/resume toggle, transaction history table
Create apps/frontend/src/components/ with reusable components: TradeTable, PnLCard, CopyModal, VaultCard, StatusBadge, TraderRow, StatsGrid, PnLChart (Recharts wrapper)

Create apps/frontend/src/hooks/ with custom hooks: useSigningRequests (handles SIGNING_REQUEST messages, calls signTransaction on wallet adapter, sends SIGNING_RESPONSE back), useTraderData, useDashboardData, useVaultData
Ensure responsive design (mobile-friendly) with Tailwind responsive classes throughout
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter frontend build succeeds (Next.js production build)
All pages render without errors in build output
Wallet adapter integration is properly configured for Phantom
WebSocket client handles all message types from the protocol spec
Dark theme applied consistently with specified colors
Vault management page allows full CRUD on vault state and risk params
Signing request flow: receive SIGNING_REQUEST -> call signTransaction -> send SIGNING_RESPONSE
verification: Run: pnpm --filter frontend test (if tests exist)
